data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the observed order (optional Filters checkbox such as RV Site, type the destination, optional check-in/check-out dates, click FIND A KOA) and names all four parameters; the only small differences are that it labels the filter "ways to stay" rather than a general amenity and adds a step to pick an autocomplete suggestion, and neither gets in the way of automating it.
